name: dsh-advanced-training
description: DSH advanced training methods as standalone tools: tail-audit (keep-the-tail dataset health check, DDSP/GSV/RVC agnostic), GPT-SoVITS UNK-elimination text patch, and reference-free A/B evaluation (ASR CER + tail-hit). The methods were validated on a 383-line corpus: tail-keeping raised last-3-char articulation 33%->93% and cut PER 0.197->0.018.
